item.title: August 29, 2026 - Don't look back
item.description: Page 251. "The steps offer 'a big change from a life dominated by guilt and remorse. Our futures are changed because we don't have to avoid those who we have harmed. As a result... we receive a new freedom that can end isolation.'" Just for Today: The steps have freed me from regrets over my past. Today, I look forward to my new life in recovery.
